summary.text: Fredrick Love, known as Fred Love, is the Arkansas state senator for the 15th District and the Democratic nominee for governor. He served in the Arkansas House from 2011 to 2023.
He is term-limited and campaigns on ending the school voucher program, regional economic development hubs, and investing in public schools and Medicaid.

paragraphs.text: Love earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in public administration from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock, and he later completed a postbaccalaureate certificate in public health at the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences and attended the Harvard Kennedy School for Senior Executives in State and Local Government.
He worked for the Arkansas Foodbank and then for Pulaski County, most recently as director of community services.
Love served in the Arkansas House from 2011 to 2023, including as House minority leader from 2019 to 2021.
Love was elected to the Senate in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023, representing District 15, which includes parts of Little Rock and Pulaski County. He is the Senate Minority Whip.
He announced his run for governor in June 2025 and won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary over Supha Xayprasith-Mays.

sources.title: Arkansas Democrats seeking nomination for governor focus on voucher program, economic development
